nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Tình huống khẩn · bài tự soạn
kind: Tin nhắn thoại báo bị lạc đường
L: Hi Lisa, it's Tom. I'm kind of lost, and my phone is about to die.
I got off the bus at the wrong stop, and now I can't find your street.
There's a big church on my left and a small bakery across the street.
I asked a man for directions, but he didn't speak much English.
Can you send me your address again, please? I'll show it to someone.
Wait, I see a police officer over there. I'll ask him.
If my phone dies, don't panic! I'll take a taxi to your place.
Thanks a lot, you're the best!

exq.a: He is lost and his phone is almost dead.
w: He missed the last bus home.
exq.why: “I’m kind of lost, and my phone is about to die.” = bị lạc và điện thoại sắp hết pin.

exq.q: Where did Tom get off the bus?
w: At the end of the line
exq.why: “I got off the bus at the wrong stop.” = xuống nhầm trạm.

exq.q: What does Tom ask Lisa to do?
exq.why: “Can you send me your address again, please?”

exq.q: What will Tom do if his phone dies?
exq.a: Take a taxi to Lisa's place
exq.why: “I'll take a taxi to your place.”
